**Summary:** The 277-aa sequence is an exact match to reviewed UniProt **P75402**, annotated as formamidopyrimidine-DNA glycosylase (**Fpg/MutM**) from *Mycoplasmoides pneumoniae*.

Fpg is involved in **base-excision repair**: it recognizes and removes damaged DNA bases, with a reported preference for oxidized purines such as **8-oxoG**. It also has **AP lyase** activity, nicking DNA after base removal. The reference annotation reports **one Zn²⁺ ion per subunit**.

The sequence has a predicted mass of about **31.9 kDa** and theoretical pI of **9.40**. Pfam scanning detects **Fapy_DNA_glyco** (residues 1–117) and **H2TH** (135–226) domains. These properties are sequence-derived or reference-annotated; they do not by themselves confirm activity in an experimental setting.
